notes.title: Development Update #20 - Fast Travel and Game Stable
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/80f013e95b01f05e101eedca59b9be536a1e1ed1.png[/img]

[h3][b]Development Update #20[/b][/h3]
[b]Fast Travel and Game Stable[/b]

[h3][b]Ver. v.1.1.1.12[/b][/h3]
If you encounter problems such as game crashes after the update, please check our general solutions first.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/3061869473048903178/

*The game has been updated and the official server is reset.


[h3][b][Controller][/b][/h3]
- Added a setting to turn the controller vibration feature on and off.
You can change this in [Settings - Gameplay - Game Settings].


[h3][b][Fast Travel][/b][/h3]
- Added Fast Travel.
- After unlocking the Survivor Shelter, you'll be able to use Fast Travel.
- How to use Fast Travel
1) Interact with the NPC located inside the Survivor Shelter.
2) Select the Survivor Shelter you wish to travel to.
3) Once the fast travel is complete, move next to the vehicle located outside the shelter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/d8052b262e5e1efdd30e7cb5bbc1f4a8a96f7eaa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/61178055f089bb6c3588e9efedbd6815815ad2e7.png[/img]

[h3][b][Balancing][/b][/h3]
- Changed the hours you can enter the Shelter (06:00 - 19:00 -> 04:00 - 21:00)
- Increased the size of the Building Forbidden Area near shelters.
- Decreased calorie consumption when characters and followers are stopped.
- Slightly increased the drop rate of gunpowder in loot.


[h3][b][Localization][/b][/h3]
- Fixed translation for Hungarian.


[h3][b][Bug Fixed][/b][/h3]
- Fixed that tattoos applied to followers were not visible on the client(guest).
- Fixed that the quantity of materials would not update correctly when crafting items on the client(guest).
- Fixed that crash occurs when the client(guest) is equipped a Nora's Pendent and hits the door of the shelter with Rapid Rush.
- Fixed that the client(guest)'s frame would stutter in certain situations.
- Fixed that character's vomit sound not being affected by audio settings.
- Fixed that fuel generator's working animation was not playing correctly.
- Fixed that some loot was floating in air.
- Fixed that some loot not being able to be interacted with.
- Fixed that some walls that lost collision detection.
- Fixed that some crashes.


Please send a crash report with specifics if a crash occurs.
If you have any problems, please send an email with the form below.
[Game Version]
[Bug]
[How to Replicate]
[Single/Multi?]
[Host/Guest?]
[Screenshot/Video if possible]

Email : support@jacktostudios.com

If you send the save file too, it will be very helpful for verification.
The save files are in “%LocalAppData%\LF\Saved\SaveGames”.

notes.title: Alpha Hotfix #085
notes.content:
[h3][b]Ver. v.1.0.1.4[/b][/h3]

If you encounter problems such as game crashes after the update, please check our general solutions first.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/3061869473048903178/


[h3][b][System][/b][/h3]
- The default value of the 'No TeamKill' setting has been changed: (Disabled -> Enabled)
*This value may not be changed in games that have already been saved.


[h3][b][Controller][/b][/h3]
- Fixed that caused the Quickslot button to intermittently not work.


[h3][b][Follower][/b][/h3]
- Fixed that followers could not properly deal damage to natural objects.
- Fixed that effects not playing when a follower hits a natural object.
- Changed that followers are no longer unequipping weapons if the follower's inventory is full.
*If a follower is equipped with a one-handed weapon and shield and switches to a two-handed weapon, then the unequipped equipment will fall to the ground.
- Fixed that followers would take damage even if they were in an armored car.
- Fixed that the sound would play multiple times when a follower pulls the bowstring.


[h3][b][Zombie][/b][/h3]
- Changed Cleon's weakness to Head.
- Cleons no longer deal a damage to near players when killed.


[h3][b][Bug Fixed][/b][/h3]
- Alleviated that zombies couldn't passing through some objects, such as doors.
*This may slightly increase the difficulty of Zombie Waves.
- Fixed that solar generators could not be built with the snap feature enabled.
- Fixed that solar generators would not generate power in some situations.
- Fixed that objects were floating in the air or overlapping.
- Fixed that food would not lose its effect after its duration expired on the client (guest).
- Fixed that flickering weapon attachments on client (guest).
- Fixed that client (guest) was unable to view information in saved files on dedicated servers.


Please send a crash report with specifics if a crash occurs.
If you have any problems, please send an email with the form below.

[Bug]

[Host/Guest?]

The save files are in “%LocalAppData%\LF\Saved\SaveGames”.

notes.title: v1.0 The Final Story - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/0f79a9d467a9950b8754e1e7354fdc99f6fc6d93.png[/img]

[h3][b]v1.0 The Final Story - Out Now![/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Ver. v.1.0.0.15[/b][/h3]
If you encounter problems such as game crashes after the update, please check our general solutions first.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/3061869473048903178/


*The game version will change upon release.
(You can still use save files from previous versions).
*All game settings will be reset following the release.
*The game has been updated and the official server is reset.


[h3][b][Controller][/b][/h3]
- Added vibration feature in some situations.
(Interaction, Driving)
- Changed default value for controller sensitivity option (1 -> 1.5)
- Changed assignment of controller default hotkeys: (Kick <-> Run)
- Warning message is now displayed when a controller is not available in the UI.
- Changed the key guide in the prologue to correspond to the controller.
- New: Controller controls are now available in some UIs.
Main Menu, Character Selection, Customization, Difficulty, Server Browser, Map, Settings, Invites, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/ac9ba9dcb1f5d196ee12b67dc728d00adfddb4ed.png[/img]

[h3][b][Follower][/b][/h3]
- Changed to prevent followers from sticking too close to players.
- Changed followers to move away from their current location when taking damage.
- Changed followers to stop firing if the target is dead when ranged.
- Fixed that the follower would repeatedly move a certain range.
- Fixed that the follower would not consume Mushroom Roast even if it was in their inventory.
- Fixed that followers would not change to bare hands when all ammo was consumed.
- Fixed that followers would perform several attacks in thin air when entering an attack state.
- Fixed that followers would not perform actions correctly when affected by some debuffs.
- Fixed that a follower would remain in the rested state when loading the game when saved in the rested state.

[h3][b][Stroy][/b][/h3]
- New story added.
- Added a dungeon to the Snowfield area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/f179f8e51d9a17abba3ed7ee66b10a2a39acd7f7.png[/img]
- Added a new Unique Zombie.
- Added “(Tutorial)” to some quests.
- Changed tutorial quests to require completion of all quests before accepting additional quests.
- Removed the Change Fire Mode mission from the Combat quest.
- Added the Reset Unique Equipment Options quest to the Survivor quests in the Snowfields area.
- Fixed that players could not completing the Unique Zombie Kill quest after killing a unique zombie.

[h3][b][Community Items][/b][/h3]
Added badges, trading cards, emojis and profile backgrounds to use on your Steam profiles.
Badges
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/b9a2f92e6e820765238d58f31124714a5f9b1e63.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/081e026ac555eec5d38f02317d8cb3c24692ee9e.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/73f7145dbeabc30c3da56bd2dd16e23cef9fed88.png[/img]

Trading Cards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/09512ec2e95a6688d258c579ae998f12bce9f518.png[/img]

Emojis
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/f1e2e7e0923495b2f419c2e6b0591b9afbf0dec7.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/21e04561b2c22bac784915a3ac9689444112df40.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/7b18c7173d46ff6512d6132c178000fa64788280.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/657be872dacbe05d165991eacfc8748ebe719bd0.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/b4d4d313cc69b29fd7311a346628789af5fe0926.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/e0302fc01f7b596331e736fd8ad24bcb3765c6a6.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/590505772fa04aae3c732ec356b30f8f74f0b09a.png[/img]

Backgrounds
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/fa8203471f8eae9fa9a4a2cae283f1a89555d9e4.png[/img]

[h3][b][Balancing][/b][/h3]
- Decreased the damage of common zombies and the HP of unique zombies on Easy and Peaceful difficulties.
- Decreased the fuel consumption of upgraded armored cars and armored boats.
- Fixed that the timing of zombie attack detection.
- Fixed the attack detection of unique zombies.


[h3][b][UX/UI][/b][/h3]
- Added a feature to display the name of a building when interacting with it.
- Changed the gauge to move more smoothly when consuming stamina.
- Removed the feature to change the category of the chat when Tabbing.

[h3][b][Sound][/b][/h3]
- Some sounds have been adjusted.
(Follower encounter sequences, NPC dialog)
- Fixed that the sound that plays when interacting.
- Added sound to the behavior of zombies.
- Added sound to the player's behavior.


[h3][b][Animation][/b][/h3]
- Fixed that follower stun animation.
- First-person skin interaction animations have been changed.


[h3][b][Items][/b][/h3]
- New items have been added.
Trophie (1 type)
Unique Uquipment (1 type)


[h3][b][Localization][/b][/h3]
- Fixed some radio lines not being translated correctly.
- Fixed inconsistencies in quest and journal descriptions in Polish.
- Fixed some awkward translations.


[h3][b][Bug Fixed][/b][/h3]
- Fixed that the game menu UI could not be closed with a hotkey.
- Fixed that quest markers being displayed for zombies that have not received a quest.
- Fixed that item slots flickering.
- Fixed that zombies would get up immediately after falling down.
- Fixed that zombies would increase the size of weapons they were equipped with.
- Fixed that Grave Looting Goods could be obatined continuously.
- Fixed that long strings of journal items could be skipped when picked up.
- Fixed that exhaustion animation playing when using all of your stamina while swimming.
- Fixed that characters could not be manipulated if they were hit at the same time as a rest interaction.
- Fixed that characters would lift their feet when overlapping another character.
- Fixed that clients (guests) could not use mechanical equipment(Chainsaw, Jackhammer, Flamethorwer).
- Fixed that the radio in the bunker escape sequence would not play on client (guest).
- Fixed that the client (guest) could not properly hit natural objects with the pickaxe.
- Fixed some crashes.

notes.title: Alpha Hotfix #084

notes.title: Alpha Hotfix #083
notes.content:
[h3][b]Ver. 3.4.3.3[/b][/h3]

If you encounter problems such as game crashes after the update, please check our general solutions first.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/3061869473048903178/


[h3][b][Controller][/b][/h3]
- Added a feature to show a key guide in the Inventory UI.
- Removed the button to split an item in half or one in the inventory when using a controller.
- Enabled scrolling in some UIs.
Crafting, Research
- Added button controls in some UIs.
Game Menu


[h3][b][Follower][/b][/h3]
- Changed followers to open their mouths when performing monologues.


[h3][b][Animation][/b][/h3]
- Fixed Javelin animation.
- Fixed fishing animation.
- Fixed sitting and moving animation while aiming the bow.


[h3][b][Graphics][/b][/h3]
- Added trail effect to zombie melee attacks.


[h3][b][UX/UI][/b][/h3]
- Changed the top bar to show when the game's screen mode is windowed.


[h3][b][Miscellaneous][/b][/h3]
- Removed some fences placed near houses.
- Added repair kits to the kiosk.
- Increased the attack detection of the Woodcutter's Axe and Pickaxe.
- Changed the game settings to auto-save when exiting the game due to a change in the game settings.


[h3][b][Bug Fixed][/b][/h3]
- Fixed that firing a shot would occur immediately after a player falls.
- Fixed that unique zombies would not change targets if the current target was dead.
- Fixed that client (guest) not being able to cancel a rest interaction.
- Fixed that client (guest) was unable to clear player markers on the map.
- Fixed that the client (guest) would play a sound twice when hitting a natural object.
- Fixed that client (guest) could not see other characters rotate.
- Fixed that the Ghost Killer's Lantern skin effect would persist after unequipping equipment.
- Fixed that game settings related to wave zombies would change to 0 when disabling No Wave on game difficulty.
- Fixed that the Save and Cancel buttons would appear to be enabled when changing controller settings.
- Fixed that skipping a sequence would work if the space bar input was held before entering the sequence.
- Fixed that caused keyboard or mouse input to be retained in some situations.
- Fixed some crashes.

notes.title: Alpha Hotfix #082
notes.content:
[h3][b]Ver. 3.4.2.18[/b][/h3]

If you encounter problems such as game crashes after the update, please check our general solutions first.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/3061869473048903178/


[h3][b][Save System][/b][/h3]
- Fixed that some data could be lost when saving a game.
(This is commonly known as the issue of seeing an X mark on the equipment icon).
If the issue has already occurred, you will not be able to recover your data.
If the above does not resolve the problem, or if you encounter any problems, please let us know via email at the bottom of the announcement.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.


[h3][b][Controller][/b][/h3]
- UI Cursor Sensitivity changed to Controller Sensitivity.
- Added new contorl settings for controllers to recommend initializing control settings.
- Added the feature to manipulate the build menu to the controller.


[h3][b][Follower][/b][/h3]
- Changed to allow followers to perform attacks in place when they are stuck.
- Changed so that followers are no longer targeted by wave zombies when they are halted.
A halted follower can still be targeted if it hits a wave zombie or if the zombie recognizes the follower.
- Changed follower behavior when waving at night.
Prioritizes attacking the closest enemies.
Engages as close to the player as possible.
- Reduced the frequency of some of the follower's monologues.
- The follower's movement ability has been improved.
- Changes have been made to prevent followers from sticking too close to players.
- Changed followers to dismount if they die while mounted on a vehicle.
- Changed to prevent followers from moving too close to bonfires.
- Changed: When a player is respawned, the follower will now move to the player's side, even if they are halted.
- Added an escape button to move selected followers to the side of the character when something goes wrong with the follower.


[h3][b][Vehicle][/b][/h3]
- The problem of vehicles flying away has been alleviated.
- We've made some changes to the way vehicles are built on top of each other to address the issue of vehicles flying into the air or falling through the ground.
As a result, some previously possible build methods may no longer be possible.
If you're having trouble with an already built vehicle and can't operate it, try demolishing the buildings on top of it one by one.
- We've changed the notification message that appears when players are unable to build on a vehicle.
If the above does not resolve the problem, or if you encounter any problems, please let us know via email at the bottom of the announcement.


[h3][b][Parry][/b][/h3]
- Parry has changed.
Parry is now unconditional instead of probabilistic.
Parry can be triggered by blocking an attack for a short period of time after assuming a shield blocking stance.
- Parry stamina cost increased.
- Parry no longer costs Guard Points.
- Shield blocking no longer takes damage if all guard points are expended.
- Options have changed in the list below (Parry Rate -> Parry Stamina Usage)
Trait, Research, Shield Fix Option, Shield Random Option
- Option removed from the list below (Parry Rate)
Shield Upgrade
- For followers, parrying is performed in the same way as before.
The parry rate is 25%.


[h3][b][Balancing][/b][/h3]
- Decreased total experience requirements up to level 10.
- Mushrooms have increased in calories.


[h3][b][UX/UI][/b][/h3]
- Added a feature to show quest markers on zombies (Sub Quest, Survivor Quest).
The feature to show quest markers can be enable / disable in the 'Settings - Gameplay - Quest Marker' option.
- Challenge difficulty has been removed from the game difficulties.
Games that were already on Challenge difficulty will remain so.
- Added warning message when selecting higher difficulties. (Survival, Legend)
- Added warning expression to the Sandbox UI to indicate that an achievement is unobtainable.
- Added hotkeys to the Fishing Success UI and Revival on Death UI.
- Changed the respawn UI to show directly after death.
- Removed the button to favorite of build materials in the build menu.
- Added tips for each category of game settings.
- Changed the order of the Game Settings options.
- Removed the UI scale option from the Game Settings section.
- The "Main Quest" option in "Settings - Gameplay - User Interface" has been changed to "Favorites".
- Added option to invert mouse while driving.


[h3][b][Sound][/b][/h3]
- Increased the size of wave music.


[h3][b][Graphics][/b][/h3]
- Added Injury Visualization.
Injuries are now visualized when zombies and animals are hit.
Injuries can be enable / disable in the 'Settings - Gameplay - Injury Visualization' option.
- Added trail effect to projectiles.


[h3][b][Items][/b][/h3]
- Added new items that can be crafted at a bonfire.
Grilled Red Mushrooms, Grilled Brown Mushrooms


[h3][b][Localization][/b][/h3]
- Fixed incorrect translations in journal. (French, Portuguese-Brazilian)


[h3][b][Miscellaneous][/b][/h3]
- Changed the difficulty level at which the No Equipment Drop on Death option is disabled.
Hard and above difficulty -> Legendary difficulty


[h3][b][Bug Fixed][/b][/h3]
- Fixed that the Torture Knife would disappear.
If your game was saved while it was already gone, it will not be recovered.
If you need to recover it, please let us know via email at the bottom of the announcement with a save file attached.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
- Fixed that prevented followers from looting synthetic objects consecutively.
- Fixed that not being able to rename a follower on the client (guest).
- Fixed that follower's stats could not be increased on the client (guest).
- Fixed that followers would stand up when riding a bike on the client (guest).
- Fixed that players could receive the Chemical Gas debuff outside of mines.
- Fixed that not being able to interact with the Survivor NPC in the Snowfield Area.
- Fixed that kicking in front of a door in the Survivor Shelter would cause the door to open.
- Fixed that Crawler Zombies would move in mid-air.
- Fixed that albino zombies would not spawn correctly.
- Fixed that the blocking shield animation would not play in first-person mode.
- Fixed that players would have reduced health when loading the game if their satiety was decreased.
- Fixed that could not be entered in the Central Grassland Area.
- Fixed that zombies would play a spinning in place animation when a character was died.
- Fixed that supplies from air drops would fly away when colliding with projectiles.
- Fixed that explosives in dungeons could sometimes not be destroyed.
- Fixed that bookmarks would not register correctly during quests.
- Fixed that animation was broken when riding a bicycle generator.
- Fixed some crashes.

Please send a crash report with specifics if a crash occurs.
If you have any problems, please send an email with the form below.
[Game Version]
[Bug]
[How to Replicate]
[Single/Multi?]
[Host/Guest?]
[Screenshot/Video if possible]

Email : support@jacktostudios.com

If you send the save file too, it will be very helpful for verification.

notes.title: Development Update #19 - The Last Development Update Before The Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/e060cf3a42d17374eb118b3704e9a79c3d61d17d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Development Update #19[/b][/h3]
[b]The Last Development Update Before The Release[/b]


[h3][b]Ver. 3.4.1.15[/b][/h3]
If you encounter problems such as game crashes after the update, please check our general solutions first.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/3061869473048903178/


*Controller support has been added, adding new hotkey settings.
This will reset all game settings, and we ask that you change your game settings again.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

*The game has been updated and the official server is reset.


[h3][b][Controller][/b][/h3]
- Some controllers are supported.
Xbox controller support
- Controller-related settings have been added to the Shortcut Key settings.


[h3][b][System][/b][/h3]
- With the addition of controller hotkeys, it has been changed so that secondary hotkeys cannot be set.


[h3][b][Multiplayer][/b][/h3]
- Changed the way multiplayer is restricted by anti-cheat protection.
Only clients with Anti-Cheat Protection enabled can connect to servers with Anti-Cheat Protection enabled.
Any client can connect to a server with anti-cheat protection disabled.
- Added UI to display anti-cheat protection. (notated as EAC).
- New: Added new launch options for games (Non_EasyAntiCheat, Non_Official).
When running the game with these options, the official servers will be inaccessible.
- Added a running batch file for dedicated servers (StartSever_Non_EasyAntiCheat.bat)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/35d5045f17af750a7e278771899b86991e3c15f8.png[/img]

[h3][b][Follower][/b][/h3]
- A Follower has been added.
- Players can hire up to three followers based on their character's level (levels 1, 50, and 99).
- Followers are placed in bunker and shelters in each region.
- Followers placed in shelters change at 0:00 every day.
- Players can order or release followers from the Follower Order menu.
- Followers follow the player and automatically engage in combat, Plant Collecting, and Synthetic Objects Looting activities as directed.
- Some interactions are limited when followers looting synthetic objects (Find, Break which requires tools)
- The follower's orders are unlocked based on the follower's level.
- Players can trade items from their followers through the Item Exchange menu.
- A follower's inventory slot increases with the follower's level.
- Followers automatically consume food from their inventory when they're low on health or satiety.
- Followers will automatically consume food that provides attribute resistance depending on the situation.
- Players can also feed food directly to followers.
- Followers automatically equip weapons in combat, depending on the situation.
The weapons a follower equips are prioritized based on the weapon's tier, rarity, and buffs.
Players cannot directly equip a Follower's weapons.
- You can equip armor to your followers from the follower inventory.
- In the follower's character information, players can increase the follower's stats and rename the follower.
- The follower performs a monologue in each situation.
- If a follower's health is low, they will be passive in combat.
- When a follower reaches 0 health, they are stunned.
A stunned follower can be woken up by player's interaction.
- Experience earned by the player and the follower is distributed based on their respective levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/1eccbfc5ccd37547422f8aa7b125f09a93306e99.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/a7b8222fb1f45f33319003761f1b9d77678bb0d1.png[/img]

[h3][b][Pierce][/b][/h3]
- Pierce attack has been changed.
When perform a pierce attack, it will dash forward.
- Pierce damage multiplier for blunt weapons has been increased.
- Pierce's stamina cost has been increased.
- Added Pierce attack for all weapons except Bare Hands, Knuckles, Gut Massager, Glaive, and Berserker's Fury.


[h3][b][Bonfire][/b][/h3]
- A bonfire has been placed in the world.
- Players can cook simple meals at the bonfire.
- Players can rest on chairs placed around the bonfire.
- If any characters get close to the bonfire, will take fire damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/a090ffa459365d8b3b8976989cf6f5ea1e78f884.png[/img]

[h3][b][Scooter][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Development Update #18 - Story Part 3, New Zombies and UI Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/0ed6029c26da476406ae761e08ce75533815140d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Development Update #18[/b][/h3]
[b]Story Part 3, New Zombies and UI Improvements[/b]


[h3][b]Ver. 3.3.0.4[/b][/h3]
If you encounter problems such as game crashes after the update, please check our general solutions first.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/3061869473048903178/


*Changed the name of the official servers.
*The game has been updated and the official server is reset.

[h3][b][Stroy][/b][/h3]
- New story added.
- Added a dungeon to the Snowfield area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/07a8b21f134b1cfcb0b16af1723f40e6af394e87.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/6839c62cc634adf8f9c5c615253d7c0e719e40c1.png[/img]
- NPC has been added to shelter in the Snowfield area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/270e8c54fc53aedab47a1b4bf92fe29410bb8d74.png[/img]
- Added a new Unique Zombie.
Pattern Overview
Phase 1
Default Attack: Performs basic melee and ranged attacks and uses Rapid Rush.
Summon Mutated Eggs: Summons 5 eggs, each of which inflicts a debuff on nearby players that reduces their chemical resistance to 0%. If the Summon pattern is performed again with an egg already summoned, the existing egg will explode. If the player destroy the egg directly, it will not explode.

Enter Phase 2
Move to the center and cause an protection-ignoring explosion.

Phase 2
Unique Zombie casts an aura that deals powerful chemical damage.
Basic attacks are reinforced.
Reduces the cooldown of Summon Mutated Eggs.
Move to the center and make an protection-ignoring attack.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/6fd14f48e25f251f70f08cfa296a41bad787158c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/41464542841c7f4c1dd14228e5d9b6b57fc7ff78.png[/img]

[h3][b][Zombie][/b][/h3]
- Unique Zombies no longer apply debuffs when encountered and phase changed.
- Reduced the duration of super armor that occurs when a light zombie attacks.
- Added new Giant Zombies.
Abomination
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/58a2e93bdae10df05602fad67ce9e5245248d080.png[/img]
Volcaino
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/e51f6eb274e960a580dcbbc216f3a1880ee64807.png[/img]
- Chemical Three Headed Smasher has been renamed. (Enhanced Three Headed Smasher)
This changes the appearance of the Enhanced Three Headed Smasher and removes the Chemical element.


[h3][b][Customization][/b][/h3]
- The Body category has been added to Customization.
The Body category allows you to change the body shape, including height.
- Added the function to change the appearance of created characters.
- For the Lucy character, the Delete Character and Change Appearance buttons have been removed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/55486440cc1702b427c89cb171e9c10c2159bd9f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/85631619dd46ca7dd02a614837650eef0eea0302.png[/img]

[h3][b][Wave Optimization][/b][/h3]
- Added a game setting to limit the number of spawning wave zombie. (Limit Wave Zombie Amount)
The default value of the feature is 200, which can be changed by Change Difficulty feature.
- If more wave zombies are spawned than the limit, the spawning of zombies will stop.
Unspawned zombies will enter the queue and will spawn in turn when the already spawned zombies die.
- This number of zombies includes only light and heavy zombies.
- At 06:00 game time, the following actions occur.
Removing zombies that have entered the queue.
Removing spawned zombies that are more than 100 meters away from the player.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/e7fbc4c773716300ce5aa0ef26e74ebdef281cf1.png[/img]

[h3][b][Game Backup System][/b][/h3]
- Added the feature to back up saved games.
- If a save is made with the same name as a file that already exists in the game, the currently saved game files are copied to the backup folder.
- The maximum number of backup files is 10, and if there are more than 10, the oldest backup file will be removed first.
- The path to the backup files is as follows.
%LocalAppData%\LF\Saved\SaveGamesBackup
- Backup files are formatted as follows.
GameName_yyyymmdd_hhmm
e.g.) Autosave_20240412_1521
- If the backup files have the same name, the more recently created file will be overwritten.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/1af39b556b1e304d8b6af9644856d608ebe0ace8.png[/img]

[h3][b][UX/UI][/b][/h3]
- Changed the overall UI related to inventory and journals.
Removed the feature to categorize items by types. (Equipment, Consumable, Miscellaneous)
The combination keys to interact with items have been changed to toggle keys (Half, One, Drop)
Handmade has been separated from inventory. (new hotkey H)
Separated character information and coil UI.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/9e59ec7d1cac012259b41389143bd87a6e768c16.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/182c0da59ab33daf471d27e1e6cf9400842425c6.png[/img]
- Changed the use of items, including equipping and unequipping equipment to only be possible in the Inventory tab.
- Dragging and dropping an item to a specific location in the Inventory UI enables interaction.
If it's interactive, it's visually indicated.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/a6d927d72d34b51eac27491b6f13c310d584548b.gif[/img]
- Suicide button moved from inventory to system menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/86eae8b511e4d671148a7785e666a5bcbb70c95e.png[/img]

- Added the feature to visualize wire connection sockets even when they are blocked by buildings.
Wire connection sockets behind highlighted buildings will not be visualized.
- Changed most interactions to be disabled when the Wire Connector is equipped.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/a7183c3423d3f938468eab107690abadd4df4870.png[/img]

[h3][b][Items][/b][/h3]
- New items have been added:
Unique Equipment (2 Kinds)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/1f17cb8ee2db3cb994ae772bacc623e45aaf2f0f.png[/img]

[h3][b][Miscellaneous][/b][/h3]
- Equipment Modification Workbench has been renamed. (Coil Workbench)
- Ranged weapon's sub parts have been changed to always work.
Tactical Light, Laser Sight
- Removed shortcuts for ranged weapon's sub parts.
- Changed the vehicle's auxiliary functions do not work when another UI is open. (Horn, Headlight, etc.)
- Polished sounds associated with player attacks.


[h3][b][Bug Fixed][/b][/h3]
- Fixed that caused player and vehicle to synchronize to the wrong location.
- Fixed that vehicle would fly into the sky when picked up and then ride.
- Fixed that skins would not be applied to Armor Stand.
- Fixed that players could fall through the terrain next to some buildings in SOC.(Special Operations Command)
- Fixed that the aim of a ranged weapon was broken after attempting to interact with an item slot in the inventory UI.
- Fixed that the player's light was not hidden in the preview of the Wood Carving Doll's Body skin.

notes.title: Development Update #17 - New Buildings, Game Stable and QOL
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/aed0575f424fd6f6d96f950b7c65bf77d5255447.png[/img]

[h3][b]Development Update #17[/b][/h3]
[b]New Buildings, Game Stable and QOL[/b]


[h3][b]Ver. 3.2.0.3[/b][/h3]
If you encounter problems such as game crashes after the update, please check our general solutions first.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/3061869473048903178/


[h3][b][Game Systems][/b][/h3]
- Changed to apply step-by-step target highlighting to animal corpse and tomb.
- Changed so that players no longer fall down when hit by a player's trap.
- The duration of Continuous Attack has been increased. (0.75 -> 1 second)
- The way the Barbed Fence deals damage has been changed.
When first colliding with a Barbed Fence -> When first colliding with a Barbed Fence / damage every 2 seconds
- When using a kick, it has been changed to rotate to the currently pointing aim point.
- Doors placed in the world have been changed to increase HP depending on the Area.
- The option to increase attack speed by reforging melee weapons has been removed.
- Camera shaking that occurs when attacking or being hit has been improved.
- Changed settings for map legend.
Accordingly, the map legend set will be reset, so please change the settings again.
- The category of Hardcore settings has been changed. (Basic -> Details)
Accordingly, please update the game settings file on the dedicated server.


[h3][b][Building][/b][/h3]
- Buildings have been added.
Watchtower, Spiked Watchtower, Seed Incubator, Coin Minting Machine
- Spiked Watchtower: No Unlock Conditions
- Watchtower: Unlocked upon clearing Main Story #4
- Seed Incubator: Unlocked upon clearing Main Story #13
- Coin Minting Machine: Unlocked upon completion of Main Story #13
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/ce662d8a5479350338b49b74ce592a723150e9ab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/297d3597bba971ebd20bc854e2009fbd1d8248b9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/15cda395e9d22e28d676baca5d1a6f8e50f0eea8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/bf3a1f685bb824a631961847025998efa39d6fe5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/1e6baf7be18d8fe3089732409665017e7e6735b3.gif[/img]


[h3][b][Revival][/b][/h3]
- Buttons have been changed and added when revival.
Changed: Spawn at Revival Point
Added: Spawn at Near Point
- At a spawn at revival point will revive at a reasonable distance from where it died.
- If you are automatically revived due to a time limit, you will revive at the revival point.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/26e3e76eefbf3c55a2cf304d3504164b9e9071f8.png[/img]

[h3][b][Electricity System][/b][/h3]
- Changed to always show a 1 block if the battery has more than zero power.
- If there is insufficient power being supplied, the wire changes to red and a warning is displayed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/8fb71bb3b239a156c90306071963427a7e8a6b76.png[/img]

[h3][b][Game Balancing][/b][/h3]
- Changed the amount of experience loss on death.
10% of current EXP -> 5% of EXP required for current level
- Changed to spawn weaker zombies near the bunker exit.
- Decreased how often zombies with severed arms perform lunge attacks.
- Added build materials for the Drone Station.
Infrared Sensor
- Removed the function to discharge power charged to the battery.
- Overall power usage has increased.
Electrical module buildings: increased power consumption
Traps: increased standby power
Ranged traps: decreased power consumption
As power usage changes, existing power systems can become overloaded and experience problems.


[h3][b][Animation][/b][/h3]
- Improved animations for player characters.
Basic animations for characters, including walking, running, and jumping
Animations performed for attacks


[h3][b][Items][/b][/h3]
- The item has been changed.
Cyclotron -> Infrared Sensor
- Added new loot boxes available in dungeons.
The following items are available
Dungeon in the Desert: Infrared Sensor
Dungeon in the Western Grassland : Coin Die
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/c174731049d31db7938f130623be3e0e5f1e30e9.png[/img]
- New items have been added:
Coin Die, Victor's Handgun, Bradley's Shovel
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/7a7bab1bf780cc3ff997ece37357faa8b2d81494.png[/img]


[h3][b][Quest][/b][/h3]
- Added quests to obtain unique equipment.
Victor's Handgun: Main Story #5 - Q2
Bradley's Shovel: Main Story #8 - Q3
Changed quests to drop items even if you've already completed them prior to the update.
- Some quests have been changed.
- The Clear the Wave quest has been changed so that it can be completed in games with the No Wave setting.


[h3][b][UX/UI][/b][/h3]
- Changed fonts for Russian.
- Added a notification about experience loss on death.
- Added a notification about running out of ammo.
- Added UI to display the remaining time for production facilities.
For production facilities that use power, the remaining time will now show 99,999 hours if the power is low.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/3e5a8c51c1062fa255b7b2f75c49347e2d474b1a.png[/img]

[h3][b][Bug Fixed][/b][/h3]
- Fixed that attack damage was incorrectly applied to a player's buildings.
- Fixed that drones were not performing tasks correctly.
- Fixed that resetting a dungeon in the Western Grasslands area would not reset some chests.
- Fixed that attack speed scaling would not apply to players (Debuffs, Researches, etc.)
- Fixed that players could see other players' legs.
- Fixed that ghost skins were being equipped by other players would retain their effects.
- Fixed that buffs not being applied when consuming food while defence with shield.
- Fixed that duplication when crafting items.
- Fixed that inventory and quickslot not syncing when consuming an item.
- Fixed that natural objects would continue to regenerate when loading a saved game.
- Fixed that the fog was removed from a location different from the current location when a client player escaped a bunker.
- Fixed that Super Armor did not work during attack with the Glaive and Berserker’s Fury.
- Fixed that the player was unable to perform the next attack for a certain period of time if the attack was canceled due to being hit during an attack.
- Fixed that the icon in the Compass UI was not erased when leaving a team.
- Fixed that icons were duplicated in the Compass UI when a client player joined a team.
- Fixed that it was not possible to attack a zombie's head with a shotgun.
- Fixed that projectiles attached to an object did not fall when the object was destroyed.
- Fixed that the projectile floating in the air when killing a zombie with a projectile.
- Fixed that items are flying away when multiple items fall from zombies or animals.
- Fixed that other players’ evasion animations did not play properly.
- Fixed that the remaining time on the buff icon was not updated even though the client player's buff was updated.
- Fixed that a zombie that was moving after hearing a noise could not react even though it heard another noise.
- Fixed that Ranged-traps would deal full damage to the player instead of 1/10th of the damage.
- Fixed that a lot of force was applied to the debris when a rock was destroyed.
- Fixed that the close shortcut key in the map UI was not visible to client players.
- Fixed that kicking was possible in certain actions. (fall down, bite, fishing, electric shock, stun, burn)
- Fixed that the loaded information would disappear if players reconnected to the game while loading a ranged weapon.
- Fixed that vehicles were not displayed Ride or Lift interaction in certain situations.
- Fixed that another character's light and belt could not hidden even when the Wooden Doll skin was being applied.
- Fixed that the light and belt of the preview character in the inventory could not be hidden when the Wooden Doll skin was being applied.
- Fixed that the camera would go through the character's torso when performing a rest interaction in first person.
- Fixed that arms being stretched out when riding a Cruiser Bike.
- Fixed some crashes.

notes.content:

A commemorative event for the addition of Story Part 2 will take place over the next two weeks.
Please take a photo with the NPC at the Survivor Shelter.

You can choose one of the rewards from the list below.

Link to uploaded screenshot

notes.title: Development Update #16 - Transmogrification DLC, Combat System and Story Part 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/f2861648edf88b388f063f82b9abe9fd016b6a62.png[/img]

[b]<EDIT>
[Ver. 3.1.1.3]
- Fixed that client player was unable to join the game.
- Fixed some crashes.[/b]

[h3][b]Development Update #16[/b][/h3]
[b]Transmogrification DLC, Combat System, Zombie AI, Story Part 2 and NPC[/b]

[h3][b]Ver. 3.1.0.4[/b][/h3]
If you encounter problems such as game crashes after the update, please check our general solutions first.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/3061869473048903178/


*Hotkeys have been changed for some features, and new hotkeys have been added.
This will reset all game settings, and we ask that you change your game settings again.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

*The game has been updated and the official server is reset.

[h3][b][DLC][/b][/h3]
- DLC added.
Beginner Pack, Civilian Combatant Pack, White Collar Civilian Pack, Ghost Killer Pack, Wood Carving Doll Pack
- Each DLC contains the following skins
Beginner Pack: Beginner's Hat, Beginner's Outfit, Beginner's Gloves, Beginner's Shoes, Beginner's Doll, Beginner's Headphones

Civilian Combatant Pack: Civilian Combatant's Hat, Civilian Combatant's Tank Top, Civilian Combatant's Gloves, Civilian Combatant's Boots, Civilian Combatant's Dog Tag

White Collar Civilian Pack: White Collar Civilian's Hat, White Collar Civilian's Suit, White Collar Civilian's Gloves, White Collar Civilian's Shoes, White Collar Civilian's Watch

Ghost Killer Pack: Ghost Killer's Mask, Ghost Killer's Jacket, Ghost Killer's Gloves, Ghost Killer's Boots, Ghost Killer's Bracelet, Ghost Killer's Lanton

Wood Carving Doll Pack: Wood Carving Doll's Face, Wood Carving Doll's Body, Wood Carving Doll's Hand, Wood Carving Doll's Foot, Wood Carving Doll's Clockwork, Wood Carving Doll's Cloak, Wood Carving Doll's Wood Knife

- By purchasing DLC, players can unlock skins that are used for mogrification.
- Skins unlocked through DLC purchases can be used for an unlimited of mogrification.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/dfcb1a142b9bed8f5a8c850267d34cd4e3b723ad.png[/img]

[h3][b][Transmogrification System][/b][/h3]
- Mogrification have been added.
- Mogrification use skin items.
Used skin items are removed.
- Existing costumes have been removed due to the addition of skin items.
Skin items can be obatined as you progress through the gameplay. (the same as existing costumes).
- The Transmogrification UI can be found in the game menu or on the Transmogrification Workbench in the Survivor Shelter.
- Equipment with transmogrification applied can be checked via the Transmogrification Socket on the equipment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/39687557aafcac6e1f641d541bdb9b38f1642e6f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/7752de6465f1883b94710357f72532def2a7298e.png[/img]

[h3][b][Combat System][/b][/h3]
[b]Weak Point[/b]
- Added the Weak Point system.
- When a zombie performs an attack or takes damage, it has a chance to reveal a Weak Point.
- Weak Point can be attacked with Kick or Stab.
- Zombies hit by a Weak Point will enter a groggy state.
Giants and Unique Zombies do not become groggy.

[b]Kick[/b]
- Kick has been added (Kick, Dropkick)
- The damage of kick is scaled by the tier of the currently equipped weapon.
- Kick or dropkick is performed based on the character's current speed.
- Successfully hitting a Weak Point with a Kick increases your combo count.
- When the combo count increases, you can use an enhanced kick, but can't use a dropkick.
- The duration of the combo count is 30 seconds.
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/5a57f2_f7b6ee18e09941939f1d6fc4a22a63bc~mv2.gif[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/5a57f2_70d269643b434fc18cd344a8f86c13eb~mv2.gif[/img]

[b]Stab[/b]
- Added a Stab.
- Melee weapons now enter an aimed (ready to stab) state when equipped and right-clicked.
- Some weapons cannot be stabbed.
This can be seen in the key guide that appears in the top left after equipping the weapon.
- Some weapons have lower stab damage compared to basic attacks.
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/5a57f2_106a07a113644ccc9a565705aaef4141~mv2.gif[/img]

[b]Relax Attack Restrictions[/b]
- Changed to allow players to move while attacking.
- Changed to allow players to attack while in mid-air.
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/5a57f2_e1b8b26811ac44fc8e93310622decd8a~mv2.gif[/img]
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/5a57f2_348a119bb190400d8f1a2542b5415847~mv2.gif[/img]

[b]Stamina Usage[/b]
- Stamina no longer uses health when depleted.
As a result, a specific animation will play when you've used up all of your stamina, and your stamina regeneration and movement speed will be reduced for a short time.
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/5a57f2_608c4f1627de4ceba2e7699afaa60566~mv2.gif[/img]

[b]Attack Animation[/b]
- Some attack animations have been changed.

[b]Zombie Combat Polishing[/b]
- Other zombies can now be knocked back or knocked over by a zombie's attack.
- Changed to perform a different attack pattern if a zombie's arm or leg is severed.
- Added a pattern for zombies to fall.
- Added a pattern for Half-Crawler to grab the player's legs.
- Added animation for zombies to rotate in place.
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/5a57f2_513bfd510b72419cbe10d2c3722bd63b~mv2.gif[/img]


[h3][b][Stroy][/b][/h3]
- New story added.
- Added a dungeon to the Western Grasslands area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/147c78816712c838c741e0736db45cda99bf857b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/d7d8f145345a4c1a0e15136ac25c2ae3fea80e8c.png[/img]

[h3][b][NPC][/b][/h3]
[b]NPC[/b]
- NPCs have been added to the world.
NPCs can be encountered while progressing through the main story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/42fccb6b50058a1d368c424a0b03459dd1c1e61c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/0ce6af6b8cfc9e44dbd4018b20261ae928e347ce.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/89b8ce6990fbef7bf72e617e464ba5268567b830.png[/img]
[b]Survivor Shelter[/b]
- Added Survivor Shelters.
- Survivor Shelters contain NPCs and workbench with specific functions.
- Survivor Shelters exist in each region.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/08b5d2e65ed04d7a4adbd2e12ca1b0c30f7eda86.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/79bdfb788d06d5f0e2a5f32d24d5eba4203428f1.png[/img]
[b]Survivor Quest[/b]
- Added Survivor Quests.
- Survivor Quests can be accepted from NPCs in the Survivor Shelter.
- Survivor Quests are quests that can be done repeatedly in an area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/457c728e004b08d3c41ebd778b9901275bbb3982.png[/img]
[b]New Objects[/b]
- Added objects that can be progressed through Survivor Quests.
- Added Albino Zombies.
Albino Zombies spawn in specific locations after accepting the Survivor Quest.
- Added the Graveyard area.
Destroy the tombs with a pickaxe can yield certain items.

*Check the legend in the map UI to see the Survivor Shelter icon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/406b9427ea97e840c0f3e84f8c4633335f8f2cfc.png[/img]

[h3][b][Unique Equipment Reassembly][/b][/h3]
- Added Unique Equipment Reassembly
- A workbench that you can reassemble unique equipment is located in the Survivor Shelter.
- Reassembly requires 5 pieces of unique equipment.
- The tier of unique equipment that can be obatined is determined by the tier of the unique equipment used for reassembly.
If it is a unique equipment whose tier has been increased, the initial tier will be applied.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/09446e37f15bba7df30581d2f1efe538f598ecad.png[/img]

[h3][b][Game Menu][/b][/h3]
- Added the Game Menu UI.
The Game Menu UI is where you can see all of the overall functionality in your game.
- Some features are restricted and are unlocked under certain conditions.
You can see how to unlock them by hovering over the feature.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/4eb9d4b5aa4c6bb5fb57794294c6dfae5b8085be.png[/img]

[h3][b][Resource Sharing][/b][/h3]
- Resource sharing has been added.
When performing interactions such as crafting and building you can use the materials present in your storage box.
- Resource sharing is automatically enabled when building a storage box.
For already built storage boxes, resource sharing is enabled.
You can toggle the resource sharing feature to an enabled/disabled state by performing additional interactions on a built storage box.
- Resource sharing has a range of 50 meters radius around the storage box.
When entering building mode or equipping a tool (Claw Hammer, Wrench and Power Drill), a storage box with resource sharing enabled will be colored light blue.
- In multiplayer, resource sharing is only possible if you are on the same team.
- This feature is not available in some interactions.
Disassembly, Reforging of Coil and Trap Modification Parts, Reassembly, Kiosk, Forge, Objects related to quests, etc.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/b7b29a644e5f297cc12326daff17c4281548fcaf.png[/img]

[h3][b][Game Systems][/b][/h3]
[b]General[/b]
- Changed default number of players when creating a room (4 -> 8)
- Added the ability to skip sequences that play during game progress (shortcut: space bar)
- Changed feet to be visible when switching to first person camera.
- Removed the defense stat that was used for the shield (it doesn't make much difference in actual performance as before).
- Enabled the "No Research Lost Upon Dying" setting on Hard difficulty. (Games already saved will need to be manually changed via difficulty change).
- Changed some items don't count towards the take all (Like quest items or books).
- Added a tutorial system for basic maneuvers in the bunker.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/7cff0140f629bd900af890076ebbe07773dfd07c.png[/img]
[b]Satiety System[/b]
- The energy system has been changed to a satiety system.
- Removed the ability to reduce satiety on death.
- Satiety is reduced over time, and for every 20 reduced, the maximum amount of health and stamina is reduced as well.
A dedicated sound will play when satiety is reduced.
- Added the ability to speed up or slow down the descrease of satiety for various actions.
- Items that restore health and satiety have been separated.
- Eating food restores satiety proportional to calories.

[b]HP[/b]
- Changed to allow you to increase your Max. HP.
Max. HP can be increased through stats, research, and more.


[h3][b][Game Balancing][/b][/h3]
[b]Combat Balancing[/b]
- Player attack speed reduced
- Player stamina recovery reduced, (18 -> 10)
- Player's noise range has been increased
- Ranged weapon stopping power has been changed.
- Range attacks now apply a percentage of the attacker's damage (ex. Hammer)

[b]Status Balancing[/b]
- Changed secondary options for stats
Vitality: Attack Stamina Usage | Dodge Stamina Usage -> Attack/Dodge Stamina Usage | Max. HP
Endurance: Damage Taken | Stamina Regeneration -> Satiety Reduction | Stamina Regeneration
Judgment: HP Recovery from Items | Evasion Rate -> HP Recovery from Items | Protection
Memory: Damage to trees, boulders and ore | Damage to Zombies -> Fishing Time | Damage to Zombies
- Added 0.1 "HP Regeneration per Second" to character's base stats.
- Reduced the amount of HP that can be gained from items, research, etc. for Damage Leeched and HP Regeneration.
- Fixed options for some armor and accessory have been changed to Max. HP.
- Added Max. HP to the random options for armor and accessory.
- Reduced the value of random options on equipment (Element Reinforcement and stat increase options)
- Increased HP Regeneration per Second of rest interaction. (1 -> 1.5)
- The amount of experience required to level up has been increased overall.

[b]Zombie Balancing[/b]
- Zombie damage and health increased (Damage: 0 to 30%, Health: 0 to 300%)
- The health and damage multipliers applied to zombies based on their habitat area have been increased.
- Reduced the amount of variation in zombie movement speed over difficulty.
- Reduced the number of light zombies spawning in the world (-30 to -50%)
- Unique zombie health has been reduced (-40 to -70%)
- Unique Zombie damage increased (10 to 70%)
- Unique Zombies now take 50% reduced damage from firearms.
- Increased the duration of the staging behavior for most attacks from unique zombies.
- Mutated Francis' spinning pattern has been reduced in its ability to pull players.
- Unique Zombies have a 100% chance to drop unique items.
- Some types of zombies that appear in waves have been modified depending on the day.

[b]Animal Balancing[/b]
- Increased HP and damage for animals in higher areas.
- Added some resistances based on the animal's area.

[b]Natural Object Balancing[/b]
- Damage to natural objects has changed.
It has been changed to make it more difficult to destroy natural objects if the equipment is not specifically for gathering. (Woodcutter's Axe, Pickaxe, Chainsaw, and Jackhammer, etc.)

[b]Quest Balancing[/b]
- Conditions for some quests have been changed and relaxed.

[b]Items Balancing[/b]
- Added painkiller to starting items.
- Added food poisoning debuff to uncooked food.
- Removed disassembly for coins.
- Removed disassembly for unique equipment.
- Added disassembly for logs.
- Reduced the amount of rope required for building.
- Added branch to the crafting of cement.
- Added rubber to the crafting of the motor.

- Limited the types of ammunition that can be obtained in the Central Grassland Area (Pistols, Submachine Guns)
- Changed the quantity of rewards in airdrops to make them more valuable instead of less.
- Changed options for 'Grave' unique equipment (Stamina Decrease per Second -> Decrease Max. HP)
- Reduced the chance of obtaining equipment of the Superior and Rare grades.
- Reduced the chance to drop each item (Weapons, Armor, Guns, Coils) from Reward Boxes.
- Reduced the droprate of Repair Kits.
- Reduced the droprate of Ammo.
- Increased the droprate of unique equipment from zombies.
- Reduced the droprate of food items such as Energy Bar and Can of Beans.
- Reduced the droprate of research materials.
- Reduced the number of crafted Mortar Ammo.
- Reduced the quantity of items purchased at the kiosk.
- Increased the price of items purchased from kiosk.
- Reduced the quantity of items dropped from natural objects.
- Reduced the quantity of items from some production facilities (Bush and Tree Farm).
- Changed so that mushrooms can be obtained from tree farms.
- Increased the amount of time animals are captured in animal traps.
- Added Stag to the list of animals caught in Mid-size Animal Trap.
- Changed the chance of catching common fish at Fishing Place to be equalized.
- Increased the chance of getting Clay from fishing.
- Added painkillers to drop from drawers.
- Added buff to Carrot Cookie (-25% satiety reduction)

[b]Trap Balancing[/b]
- Changed options for trap modification parts.
Trap Modification Plate: Damage taken from Zombies
Trap Modification Blade: Damage to Zombies
Trap Modification Armor: Poison Gas Chance when Attacking
Trap Modification Sting: Smash Chance when Attacking
Trap Modification Core: Electric Explosion Chance when Attacking

[b]Research Balancing[/b]
- Some researches have been added and deleted.
- Options for some researches have been changed.
- Increased the amount of research materials consumed depending on the difficulty of obtaining the research.


[h3][b][UX/UI][/b][/h3]
- Added to display the HP of unique zombies.
- Added current HP, Stamina, and Satiety to the character information UI.
- Added a notification messages when attempting to attack with a weapon with 0 durability.
- Added notification messages for quest rewards.
- Changed the wave start UI.
- Changed the level up notification message.
- Changed notification messages so they don't interfere with mouse clicks.
- Changed item drop messages to be combined for items of the same type.
- Changed item earning prompts to not be displayed when using research materials and books.
- Added buff icons to show the remaining time.
- Changed the effects drawn on screen when healing and getting hit.
- Added color to the durability bar based on the current durability of the equipment (Step 3 -> Step 4)
- Changed the sound played when adjusting the scroll bar in the Customization UI.
- Changed item values to be displayed to one decimal place.
- Changed the UI to show equipped weapons when mounted so that it doesn't disappear.
- In the Research UI, the location of research is now sorted by difficulty to obtain.
- Changed the character information UI to show details first.
- Changed highlighted targets to be more visible.


[h3][b][Items][/b][/h3]
- New items have been added:
Food (2 kinds)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/25e26e823ecc285d8bd1df72be8bd6ee1bdb0f35.png[/img]
General Equipment (2 kinds)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/0fba8c7e562bc627322aa703e8e57b0f1cb9c5fa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/8fb6233158d809248c2c6ec296b35fa0552134f2.png[/img]

- As NPCs were added, some of the main quests were modified.
- A UI has been added to show quest items during the quest.
- The radio for quests accepted when acquiring unique equipment has been removed.
- The overall number of radio received during the quest has been reduced.
- A radar operation sequence has been added when repairing a radar device.

[h3][b][FX][/b][/h3]
- Added an effect when hitting water.
- Changed the sound of hitting and destroying bushes.
- Added ambient sounds.
- Reduced the duration of alarm sounds.


[h3][b][Animation][/b][/h3]

- Fixed that footstep sounds would play repeatedly when a character revives.
- Fixed that some zombies would move despite having the Shock debuff applied to them.
- Fixed that giant zombies not colliding with buildings built on top of vehicles.

- Fixed that some objects' collision.
- Fixed that flickering acquisition notification.
- Fixed that not being able to set the resolution in the graphic settings.

notes.title: Development Update #15 - Building Upgrade, Game Stable and QOL
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/8ccb58522854ae943edcc0a2d7b2f3ac1ba8ca11.png[/img]

[h3][b]Development Update #15[/b][/h3]
[b]Building Upgrade, Game Stable and QOL[/b]


[h3][b]Ver. 3.0.0.41[/b][/h3]
If you encounter problems such as game crashes after the update, please check our general solutions first.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/3061869473048903178/

*If you wish to continue using save files from a previous version (Ver. 2.4.1.2 or earlier), please refer to the information below.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/4033598370574171076/

*The game has been updated and the official server is reset.

[h3][b][Game Systems][/b][/h3]
- An option to disable anti-cheat and launch the game has been added when starting the game.
Please note that disabling anti-cheat will restrict access to multiplayer play.
- A popup that waits for searching server session has been added for multiplayer usage.
- A popup for loading save files from previous versions has been added.
- A global illumination option has been added to the graphics settings.
- Sound effects have been added to the notify message.


[h3][b][Building][/b][/h3]
- Building upgrades have been added.
Module, Electricity, Trap(Melee, Utility)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/e0a473e6c65e2643e0466a0dff3c8541438fe1c7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/d97f517242053470f6dbfce20594a172e90391d6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/66574d6b83fd06be44c8680d96a2b92f29e8189d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/fb8db60d43db087abc276efdfd1962685a0b1839.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/d4b73f8c3db7504c395bc9cfa28c9485d1603b81.png[/img]

[h3][b][Dungeon][/b][/h3]
- The method of entering dungeons has been changed to require the consume of a card key.
- Interactions with already opened dungeon doors have been disabled.
- The conditions for dungeon doors to close have been changed. (Unique zombie is killed and there are no players inside the dungeon.)
- When a dungeon closes and there is a player's corpse bag inside, the corpse bag will now be moved to the entrance of the dungeon.
- The drop rate of equipment from unique zombies has been increased.


[h3][b][Map][/b][/h3]
- Improvements have been made to the map system.
Outlines have been added to the icons displayed on the map.
The font displayed on the map has been changed.
The graphic of the map has been changed.
Due to the map changes, the previously stored fog of war may not function properly. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
- Quest markers have been added.
- A feature to select the types of markers displayed on the map has been added.
- The coordinates of objects displayed on the map have been overall adjusted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/03cc5798045e5c0a57fa25bcda14fd237bee2ee7.png[/img]

[h3][b][Game Balancing][/b][/h3]
[b]Items Balancing[/b]
- The probability of obtaining special minerals in mines has been increased.
- Mining machines have been modified to allow the acquisition of special minerals.
The types of special minerals that can be obtained depend on the area where the mining machine is installed.

[b]Combat Balancing[/b]
- The resistance system has been changed.
The damage reduction by resistance has been altered to apply 75% of the resistance value. (e.g., 100% fire resistance -> 75% reduction in fire damage received)
- The amount of 'damage dealt absorbed as HP' has been decreased. (equipment options, research, coil skills)
- The maximum value of 'damage on consecutive hits' has been reduced. (Gut Massager)

[b]Zombie Balancing[/b]
- The health and damage multipliers applied to zombies based on their habitat area have been increased.
- As the in-game date progresses, the proportion of heavy zombies generated in waves has increased.
- The resistance values of zombies have been changed.
- Attack attributes have been added to some zombies.
- Debuffs have been added to the attacks of some zombies.

[b]Building Balancing[/b]
- Buildings Have been balanced.
Railgun Trap : Changed Build Material
Trap Contorller : Changed Build Material
Electronic Equipment Workbench : Changed Build and Repair Material
- The tools required for interacting with buildings have been adjusted to be appropriate for each building's stage.

[b]Electricity Balancing[/b]
- Electricity buildings have been balanced.
Multiple Rocket Launcher : Increased Power Consumption and Power Limit.
Trap Controller : Increased Power Limit
Large Illuminator : Decreased Power Limit


[h3][b][Items][/b][/h3]
- Quests have been modified so that card keys can no longer be repeatedly obtained through them.
- World loot has been changed to allow the acquisition of card keys. (from reward boxes, zombies)
- A kiosk selling card keys has been added. (Access Card Kiosk)
This kiosk can be found in the department store.
- Card keys in the inventory have been updated to stack.
- Old costumes have been converted into equipment. (Old costumes obtained as costumes remain the same.)
- New items have been added:
Access Card (2 kinds)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/ab0e264ae7b57c153f2cf6af671f97740678e2ba.png[/img]
Access Card Fragment (5 kinds)
Access Card Fragment can be obtained from unique zombies in each regional dungeon.
The use for this item will be added in a future update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/ab0dab8538aef583708e7bc1911bc0b2dabb4d1a.png[/img]
Victor's Medal
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/3dee6564fb5d8974b8478dafbac2be13864d8a4a.png[/img]

[h3][b][Animals][/b][/h3]
- Crocodile lore animations have been added.


[h3][b][Quest][/b][/h3]
- The voice of the NPC has been changed.


[h3][b][Graphic][/b][/h3]
- Game graphic have been polished.


[h3][b][Bug Fixed][/b][/h3]
- An issue where materials were not properly returned after demolishing a building following a game save has been fixed.
- The unnatural mouse movement when dragging the map has been corrected.
- A bug where the drone station was indicated as operating (ON) despite not receiving power has been resolved.
- The discrepancy between the character's actual location and their map representation has been fixed.
- A bug where pings remained after a team member logged out of the game has been addressed.
- Fixed some crashes.
- An issue where some buttons appeared highlighted even without mouse hover has been corrected.
- The problem of radio messages not playing in the received order has been fixed.

[b]<EDIT>
[Ver. 2.3.0.11]

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.[/b]


[h3][b]Ver. 2.3.0.6[/b][/h3]

If you encounter problems such as game crashes after the update, please check our general solutions first.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/3061869473048903178/


[h3][b][Game Systems][/b][/h3]
[b]Put All[/b]
- Added the Put All feature.
Put All: Put all items in the inventory that can be put into the storage.
Put: Put all items in the inventory that are of the same type as the item in the storage.
The default hotkey for Put and Put All are F and G.
If this is not the case, please change the 'Shortcut Key 1 and 2' in the control settings or change to the default values.

[b]Protection[/b]
- Added Protection system.
Damage taken has been changed to be affected by Protection.
As your Protection increases, player take less damage.
As a result, most of the Damage Taken options have been changed to Protection, including Traits, Stats, Research and Equipment.
Added Protection to all armor.


[h3][b][Game Balancing][/b][/h3]
[b]Items Balancing[/b]
- Loot drop rates have been changed.
Drop rate of Sulphur from Rocks
Drop rate of Sulphur from Mining Machine
Drop rate of Gunpowder from Reward Box
Drop rate of 5 won from Dungeon Box
Drop rate of Gunpowder, Rubber, and Plastic from Zombies

- Crafting materials have been changed.
Trap Machine requires 1 less Plastic and 1 less Copper to craft
Engine and Motor require 1 more Plastic and 1 more Copper to craft
Material from disassembling Wrench changed to Iron Ingot
Material from disassembling an Power Drill has been changed to Duralumin Ingot

- Build materials have been changed.
Storage Box requires 1 less Plastic to build
Storage Box requires 1 more Rubber Ring to upgrage

- Increased the HP of Light Zombies in the 1-5 day wave.

- Decreased the chance of Bears appearing in the Central Grassland region.

- Decreased the overall HP of natural objects in the Grasslands region.

- Increased the chance of Aluminum, Magnesium, and Titanium Ore spawns in the Desert and Snowfield.

- Added Piece of Aluminum and Titanium.
Piece of Aluminum and Titanium can be obtained from natural objects that drop Aluminum and Titanium.
Pieces also obtained when disassembling Aluminum and Titanium Ore.
The repair materials for some buildings have been changed (Aluminum Ingot -> Piece of Aluminum, Titanium Ingot -> Piece of Titanium).

- Changed so that the Cyclotron can no longer be obtained from Victor and Francis.

- Increased the number of stacks of arrows in inventory (60 -> 80)


[h3][b][UI/UX][/b][/h3]
- The UI of the Journal has changed.
Changed the top entry from the NPC's name to the quest name.
Added information about unlocking buildings to rewards.

- The location of the Radio Communication UI has been changed.

- Changed fonts for some languages
Korean, English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese-Brazilian, Italian, Polish, Hungarian, Turkish

- Fixed that Unique Zombies' drop rate was not differentiated by region.

notes.title: Development Update #14 - Story Part 1, Dungeon and Unique Zombie
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/e1d1b4eba91dd31f36f30a55dde539b2cec3a9b8.png[/img]

[h3][b]Development Update #14[/b][/h3]
[b]Story Part 1, Dungeon and Unique Zombie[/b]

Hello, this is Jacktostudios.
We would like to express my gratitude for your continuous support and interest.
With the addition of new stories and quests, we have undertaken a large amount of translation work.
At this point, we would like to notify you that you might encounter some awkward translations within the game, including NPC dialogues, quest descriptions, and journal UI sections.
These imperfections could potentially impact the immersion of the game and need revisions to provide the flawless gaming experience we all desire.
However, accomplishing translations with a high level of accuracy and completeness is becoming challenging with our current resources alone.
Consequently, we are reaching out to ask for your assistance in reviewing the translations.
If you are interested in participating, please let us know through the email address provided below. We will then guide you on how you can contribute to this effort.
support@jacktostudios.com


[h3][b]Ver. 2.2.0.56[/b][/h3]
If you encounter problems such as game crashes after the update, please check our general solutions first.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1377380/discussions/0/3061869473048903178/

*The default setting for Times per day has been changed to 4 hours.
If you prefer to play the game for 3 hours as before, please use the game difficulty change.

*We recommend starting with a new game as added a new system.
*The game has been updated and the official server is reset.

[h3][b][Story Systems][/b][/h3]
[b]Prologue[/b]
- A prologue has been added.
- When you first enter the game, you will enter the Prologue.
- The Prologue is the beginning of the game's story, where you can acquire various items needed to progress through the game.
- In the prologue, you will be given a tutorial on the basic controls to progress through the game.
- After the prologue, you can continue to play the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/97fb883110c0907e420624c7aae0c4760b0c42d6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/73efccf7cb05472563643f1d83831e657ef082d6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/7e6e4203dffc871924cf207e90d52ab2fed599b6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/1a65c2ec0304e2401eab3d880d67db6bc6567d76.png[/img]

[b]Story[/b]
- The story system has been reorganized.
- As a result, the existing stories have been removed.
Quest item removed.
- You can now receive quests from five NPCs.
- Quests consist of main quests that follow the story, and side quests that utilize various features of the game.
- Quests are automatically accepted and completed as you play the game.
- Some quests will be added in the future.
- If your NPC's dialog is not showing up correctly, please check the "Subtitles" option in the Gameplay Settings.

[b]Dungeon[/b]
- Three dungeons have been added to each region of the island.
The remaining dungeons will be added at a later date, along with the rest of the story.
- Dungeons have a construction restriction zone that is not affected by game settings.
- To enter a dungeon, you must have certain items in your possession.
Items to enter a dungeon can be obtained through the progression of the main quest.
- Dungeons contain traps that are specific to the dungeon.
- Powerful Unique Zombies exist in the deepest parts of each dungeon.
- If certain circumstances are met, the dungeon is reset.
After killing the Unique Zombie, you re-enter the dungeon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/ea583089d0d524490a75c26c835b48c8da59a370.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/ab66b53b0019b50415f0c6d7d1be2489bc613bf0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/f2c4ff99e77f43c676cbfd61581a0c9e4c06ad6c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/ae3240f2674416da02d6a85752707a5250e81f25.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/d12cd5999755f2a2a0324f795ebc0bb9d25081f3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/fd338d211a744ec8685a16d32b0f3ee80cd34e69.png[/img]

[b]Unique Zombie[/b]
- Added Unique Zombies.
- The Unique Zombie spawn in dungeons in each region.
- Each Unique Zombie has a special pattern and appearance.
- The Unique Zombie have a high drop rate by default, and a low chance to drop special equipment unique to them.
- Under certain circumstances, the Unique Zombie will be reset.
Leave the room without killing the Unique Zombie.
Kill the Unique Zombie and re-enter the dungeon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/b4fbf69480a7a104110feb17b62bba31fde36ae7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/52db5cdf7d14a6101985271eb20ca429f21bfc0a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/21a57eb7e5914967d8734c47c5b43d9da7c80e3b.png[/img]

[b]Story Journal UI[/b]
- As stories change, the journal UI has been redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/ebe84f96b1e078d06159b4186b382985b7b9f363.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/e8f9bcb235260fefa7dbc4d5e72449abcabb8b6a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/47b3646885ffa902a9ba7b007a23ec80cd8570e9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/f165e12dbe7b73e7e160f9e65bc0199332cf8c9f.png[/img]

[h3][b][Game Systems][/b][/h3]
[b]Favorite[/b]
- Favorites added.
- You can add build and crafting materials to your Favorites.
- You can find the favorites on the left side of the game screen.

[b]AI[/b]
- Added the ability for zombies to turn their heads to look at the character.
- New light zombies have been added.
Electric Zombie, Elite Factory Zombie, Elite Mine Zombie, etc.
- Animation of zombies and animals have been polished.

[b]Equipment[/b]
- Added category for Accessory.
New categories: Pauldron, Belt
- This changes the categorization of existing Accessory.
- Added Power Drill.
The Power Drill is a parent tool to the wrench.
Power Drill's interaction is faster than other tools.
Power Drill can repair, upgrade, and demolish any building.

[b]Building[/b]
- Added a system for sequentially unlocking buildings as you progress through the game.
- This does not apply to existing save files.
- A new building has been added.
Added the Electronic Equipment Workbench.

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
- Added a time limit to revive. (60 seconds)
After the time is up, players will automatically revive.
- Removed the highlight that was displayed on natural objects.
- Changed the start time of the game to 10:00.
- Changed the default time of day to 4 hours.
- Changed the location of some books.
- Changed tooltips for book items.
Removed coordinate information from tooltip.
Added acquire area information to the tooltip.
Coordinate information for books is provided through quests.
- Added the function to cancel while loading a shotgun.


[h3][b][Game Balancing][/b][/h3]
[b]Items Balancing[/b]
- The types of fish that could be obtained by fishing were separated by region.
- Fishing kiosks have been separated by region accordingly.
- Changed the prices of some items sold in the kiosk.
- Reforge materials have been changed.
- The items obtained from disassembling equipment have been changed to match the tier of each equipment.
- Changed to allow lower tier parts to drop in higher regions.

[b]Electricity Balancing[/b]
- Electricity buildings have been balanced.
Solar Panel, Fuel Generator: increased generation power.
Trap Controllers : increased power limit.
Battery : increased power limit and power capacity; increased input sockets.
Railgun Trap: decreased power consumption.

[b]Building Balancing[/b]
- Changed the build material of the Flamethrower trap.
- Increased fuel storage for Fuel Generator.

[b]Zombie Balancing[/b]
- Changed the spawn area for some Light Zombies.


[h3][b][Items][/b][/h3]
- Changed the crafting tables for some items.
Electronic Equipment Workbench : Plasma Sword, Plasma Longsword, Plasma Shield, Railgun Ammo
- Added unique zombie trophies (3 types)
- Added the Cyclotron.
Cyclotrons drop from Unique Zombies.
More uses for the Cyclotron will be added at the future.
- Cherry and Blueberry's tier have been changed (1T -> 2T)
- New Equipment Added. (10종)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38405938/c5520d12799ada5942338c49cf6188e285946be0.png[/img]


[h3][b][UI/UX][/b][/h3]
- The UI of Inventory has changed.
- The UI of Settings has changed.
- Changed fonts for some languages.


[h3][b][Sound][/b][/h3]
- Changed the song in the main menu.
- Changed the song that plays in battle.


[h3][b][Graphic][/b][/h3]
- Game graphic have been polished.

[h3][b][Optimization][/b][/h3]
The following optimizations have been progressed
- Trap Optimization
- Game saves Optimization


[h3][b][Bug Fixed][/b][/h3]

- Fixed that the animations not playing correctly when another character is equipped with a tool.
- Fixed that the life leech's effect would not play correctly.
- Fixed that dropped items would disappear when getting them up with a full inventory.
- Fixed that stats increased by equipment were not applied correctly.
- Fixed that the trap's loaded ammo would disappear when a ranged trap was destroyed.
- Fixed that items would fly away when a mutated animal was killed.
- Fixed that remain fire when some buildings destroyed.
- Fixed that Wound resistance would not resist Critical and Headshot attacks.
- Fixed that zombies exploding on death not dealing damage and debuffs correctly.
- Fixed that players would fly away when hit by the Meat Mallet Trap.
